description:
Title: Storage management

First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the  product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.
After the ordered product has arrived it's registered in the stock management system.
Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.
If the order is ready for shipment, a courier is requested and the products are packed simultaneously and finally shipped.
If it isn't then the next product from the order is selected and the process starts again with checking if this order is in stock or not.

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from the automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckEntry" name="Merge into stock check"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check if the product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockDecision" name="Product in stock?"/>

        <bpmn:timeDuration>P10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty from the wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PenaltyDemanded" name="Delivery delay penalty demanded"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in the stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockPathMerge" name="Merge stock paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check if the whole order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Order ready for shipment?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" name="Request courier and pack products"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request a courier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FulfillmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from the order"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_StorageManagement" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckEntry" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CheckEntry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckEntry" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_CheckEntry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckEntry_CheckStock" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckEntry" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockYes_Withdraw" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">inStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNo_Reorder" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not inStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Task_WaitForArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitArrival_Register" sourceRef="Task_WaitForArrival" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Boundary_DemandPenalty" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_DelayThreshold" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DemandPenalty_End" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="EndEvent_PenaltyDemanded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_StockMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockPathMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_StockMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockPathMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMerge_CheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_StockPathMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReady_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_Fulfillment" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderReady</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady_SelectNext" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not orderReady</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fulfillment_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fulfillment_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_Join" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_FulfillmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_FulfillmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_FulfillmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
